The receiving tool reads BCF 2.1 only. Export the same issues as BCF 2.1 and say what does not carry over.
notCarried: extensions.xml: the BCF 3.0 lists of allowed topic types, statuses, priorities, labels and users have no file in this 2.1 export
PerspectiveCamera/AspectRatio: BCF 2.1 has no aspect ratio
The Comments and Viewpoints lists move out of Topic to the end of the markup file (structure, not loss)
cards.result: valid against buildingSMART's official BCF 2.1 schema files and read back (1 topic(s)); some information does not carry over
cards.schemaNote: The parts are validated against buildingSMART's official BCF-XML v2.1 schema files, kept unchanged beside the script, because the installed bcf-client 0.9.0 lacks schema files (v3/xsd/documents.xsd among them). The official 2.1 visinfo.xsd allows a perspective FieldOfView of 45 to 60 degrees; the export uses 60 and the script checks the range as well.

cards.card: Find the clashes with a second tool and compare, instead of trusting one clash engine.
cards.limitation: Box arithmetic is not a clash engine: it is right here only because each built volume equals its box volume (the wall: less the opening). Any sloped, curved or hollow element would stop the script instead of giving an answer.
cards.result: IfcOpenShell clash tree (collision mode) and box arithmetic agree on every pair; the box route only holds because every element here is box-shaped, which the script checks. Validation exception: IfcClash 0.9 intersection mode (tolerance 0.002 m) reports no clash here, although its collision mode and the box route both find ['#45=IfcWall']. It is recorded and not relied on. Do not read an empty result from one mode as no clash.
